videos.why: The only ready Short by rank: Mexico, flagged and labelled, lifts off the map in frame 0 with a claim a stranger can picture (it won't stop at Spain), and a payoff that lands on another continent (Morocco, Algeria, Tunisia).
strengths: Two countries everyone knows, named in the first line, answer held back
True-scale lift and compare: the answer is two shapes on the map
Payoff is a surprise read off the overlay: Mexico laid on Spain reaches Africa
risks: The figures are only ratios (3.9x land, 2.7x people), no absolute sizes
18 s without a close shot (craft note)
